# Forgetty Socket API

The `forgetty` server (`forgetty server run`) serves a JSON-RPC 2.0 control plane
on a Unix domain socket. The `forgetty` CLI, scripts and agents use it. A paired
device uses the same methods over protocol v2 (`forgetty/rpc/2`, see
`docs/architecture/PROTOCOL_V2.md`) where a method is marked `v2: yes`.

This file is generated from the method table in
`crates/forgetty-socket/src/api.rs`. Do not edit it by hand. Regenerate it with:

```sh
forgetty api list --markdown > docs/socket-api.md
```

A test fails when this file is out of date. The same data is served live:
`forgetty api list` and `forgetty api describe METHOD` (JSON Schemas included).

## 1. Connection

The server binds `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/forgetty/forgetty.sock`. Without
`XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` it uses `/tmp/forgetty-<uid>/forgetty.sock`.
`forgetty --state-dir DIR` places it under `DIR/run/forgetty/`.
`forgetty server run --socket-path PATH` overrides the path.

```sh
SOCK="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp/forgetty-$(id -u)}/forgetty/forgetty.sock"
```

Access control:

- The socket directory has mode `0700`. The server refuses to start if the
  directory belongs to another uid, is a symlink or has group or other bits.
- The socket file has mode `0600`.
- The server checks `SO_PEERCRED` on every connection and drops a peer with
  another uid. It reads nothing from that peer.
- The CLI checks that the socket belongs to the current uid and is not a
  symlink before it connects.

Any process of the same user can connect. That is how `socat`, scripts and
agents drive the server. The socket has no network exposure.

## 2. Wire format

Requests and replies are one JSON object per line.

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"list_tabs","params":{},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"tabs":[]},"id":1}
```

A failed call has `error` instead of `result`:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","error":{"code":-32602,"message":"missing param: pane_id"},"id":1}
```

Ids are UUID v4 strings. The connection stays open and can carry more requests,
except after a `subscribe_*` ack.

### Streams

- `subscribe_layout` replies with `{"ok":true}`, then sends one JSON-RPC
  notification (no `id`) per line. The connection is server-to-client only.
  Any byte the client writes ends the subscription. Open a second connection
  for more requests.
- `subscribe_output` replies with `{"ok":true}`, then the connection carries
  binary frames: `[u32 big-endian length N][N bytes]`. The cap is 4 MiB
  (`MAX_FRAME_SIZE`). The server drops what the client writes. Close the
  socket to end the stream.

`subscribe_output` replay (AD-013): the first frame can be a replay blob from
the byte-log ring (1 MiB by default). Later frames are live output. Replay and
live frames never overlap, so a client feeds all frames to its VT parser as
they come.

A slow reader of `subscribe_layout` can miss events, because events share the
server's broadcast channel. `forgetty wait` checks `get_pane_info` every 2 s
for that reason.

### Notifications of `subscribe_layout`

| Notification | Params |
|---|---|
| `tab_created` | `{"workspace_idx":n,"tab_id":"uuid","pane_id":"uuid"}` |
| `tab_closed` | `{"workspace_idx":n,"tab_id":"uuid"}` |
| `pane_split` | `{"tab_id":"uuid","parent_pane_id":"uuid","new_pane_id":"uuid","direction":"horizontal"\|"vertical"}` |
| `tab_moved` | `{"workspace_idx":n,"tab_id":"uuid","new_index":n}` |
| `active_tab_changed` | `{"workspace_idx":n,"tab_idx":n}` |
| `active_workspace_changed` | `{"workspace_idx":n}` |
| `workspace_created` | `{"workspace_idx":n,"workspace_id":"uuid","name":"..."}` |
| `workspace_renamed` | `{"workspace_idx":n,"workspace_id":"uuid","name":"..."}` |
| `workspace_deleted` | `{"workspace_idx":n,"workspace_id":"uuid"}` |
| `workspace_color_changed` | `{"workspace_idx":n,"workspace_id":"uuid","color":"#RRGGBB"\|null}` |
| `workspaces_reordered` | `{"from_idx":n,"to_idx":n,"from_workspace_id":"uuid","to_workspace_id":"uuid"}` |
| `active_pane_changed` | `{"workspace_idx":n,"tab_id":"uuid","pane_id":"uuid"\|null}` |
| `label_changed` | `{"target":"workspace"\|"tab"\|"pane","id":"uuid","label":"..."}` |
| `pane_created` | `{"pane_id":"uuid"}` |
| `pane_exited` | `{"pane_id":"uuid","exit_code":n\|null}`, sent before `pane_closed` (alone for a kept pane) |
| `pane_closed` | `{"pane_id":"uuid"}` |
| `title_changed` | `{"pane_id":"uuid","title":"..."}` |
| `cwd_changed` | `{"pane_id":"uuid","cwd":"/path"}` |
| `status_changed` | `{"pane_id":"uuid","status":"waiting","message":"..."\|null}`, only when the status really changes |
| `notification` | `{"pane_id":"uuid","title":"..."\|null,"body":"..."}` |

`forgetty events --json` prints each notification as `{"event":"StatusChanged", ...params}`.

### Pane state

`list_tabs` and `get_pane_info` carry what the OSC scanner (AD-019) found:

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `title` | Last OSC 0 or 2 title, sanitised, 256 characters at most. |
| `cwd` | Last OSC 7 directory. Once a pane reported one it wins over `/proc/<pid>/cwd`. |
| `status` | `{status, message, kind, progress, app, record_id}` from OSC 7501. |
| `last_notification` | `{title, body, at_ms}` of the last OSC 9, 99 or 777 notification, else `null`. |

`status.status` is `idle` (also when nothing was reported), `working`,
`waiting`, `done` or `failed`. With several records (`id=`), the pane shows the
most urgent: waiting, failed, working, done, idle. `working` and `waiting`
end when the process exits or a new shell prompt starts (OSC 133 `A`).
All text is untrusted: control characters and bidi overrides are removed and the
length is capped. Notifications are limited to 10 per second per pane.

## 3. Errors

| Code | Name | When |
|---|---|---|
| `-32700` | `parse_error` | The request is not valid JSON. |
| `-32600` | `bad_request` | The JSON-RPC version is not `"2.0"` or `method` is empty. |
| `-32601` | `method_not_found` | Unknown method. Also the sync methods when the iroh endpoint is not running (the message says `sync endpoint not available`). |
| `-32602` | `bad_request` | A param is missing or malformed, or the pane, tab or workspace does not exist. |
| `-32603` | `internal_error` | The handler failed. |
| `-32001` | `server_busy` | `shutdown` with `if_idle` while clients are attached, or the server is stopping. |

The CLI (`forgetty api call`) prints `bad_request` and `method_not_found` by
name. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 bad command line or `bad_request`, 3 target
or method not found (or ambiguous target), 4 server unreachable, 5 `wait` timed out.

Over protocol v2 the error codes map to `unknown_method`, `not_found`,
`bad_request` and `internal`. Methods marked `v2: no` are refused over v2 with
`unknown_method`: `send_input`, `resize_pane`, `list_clients` and event
subscription have v2 forms of their own, and a paired device cannot open
pairing windows.

A server built with `--features qa-tools` also answers `qa_*` methods on the
local socket for the client test suites. A normal build returns
`method_not_found`.

### `api.list`

List every method with a one-line summary.

Returns the name, summary, kind and v2 availability of each method. Use `api.describe` for the schemas and examples of one method.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Params**

None.

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `methods` | array of `ApiListEntry` | yes |  |

`ApiListEntry`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | yes | `call`, `stream` or `lifecycle`. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `remote` | boolean | yes | A paired device may call it over protocol v2. |
| `summary` | string | yes |  |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"api.list","params":{},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"methods":[{"name":"list_tabs","summary":"List all panes.","kind":"call","remote":true}]},"id":1}
```

### `api.describe`

Describe one method: schemas and examples.

Returns the description, the JSON Schema of the params and of the result, and an example request and response. An unknown method gives `method_not_found` (-32601). A missing `method` gives `bad_request` (-32602).

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | string | yes | Method name, for example `list_tabs`. |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | yes |  |
| `kind` | string | yes | `call`, `stream` or `lifecycle`. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `params_schema` | any | yes | JSON Schema of `params`. |
| `remote` | boolean | yes | A paired device may call it over protocol v2. |
| `request_example` | any | yes | Example `params`. |
| `response_example` | any | yes | Example `result`. |
| `result_schema` | any | yes | JSON Schema of `result`. |
| `summary` | string | yes |  |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"api.describe","params":{"method":"list_tabs"},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"name":"list_tabs","summary":"List all panes.","description":"...","kind":"call","remote":true,"params_schema":{},"result_schema":{},"request_example":{},"response_example":{"tabs":[]}},"id":1}
```

### `list_tabs`

List all panes.

Returns one entry per live pane in creation order, with size, directory, title, exit state, program status (OSC 7501), last notification and label. A pane that exited and was kept (`remain_on_exit`) stays listed with `exited: true`.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Params**

None.

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabs` | array of `PaneEntry` | yes |  |

`LastNotification`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `at_ms` | integer | yes | Unix time in milliseconds. |
| `body` | string | yes |  |
| `title` | string or null | no |  |

`PaneEntry`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cols` | integer | yes |  |
| `cwd` | string | yes | Working directory to show (OSC 7 hint, else the real directory). |
| `exit_code` | integer or null | no |  |
| `exited` | boolean | yes | Process has exited and the pane was kept. |
| `label` | string | yes | User label (`set_label`). Empty when none. |
| `last_notification` | `LastNotification` or null | no |  |
| `pane_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `pid` | integer or null | no | Process id of the child, if known. |
| `remain_on_exit` | boolean | yes | Pane stays listed after its process exits. |
| `rows` | integer | yes |  |
| `spawn_cwd` | string | yes | Real working directory (used for new tabs and splits). |
| `status` | `PaneStatus` | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes | Last title the program set. |

`PaneStatus`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app` | string or null | no | Program name. |
| `kind` | string or null | no | `permission`, `question` or `auth` (only while `waiting`). |
| `message` | string or null | no | Free text from the program. |
| `progress` | integer or null | no | Progress, 0 to 100. |
| `record_id` | string or null | no | Id of the status record. `null` is the root record. |
| `status` | string | yes | `idle`, `working`, `waiting`, `done` or `failed`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"list_tabs","params":{},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"tabs":[{"pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35","pid":4242,"rows":24,"cols":80,"cwd":"/home/vick","spawn_cwd":"/home/vick","title":"bash","remain_on_exit":false,"exited":false,"exit_code":null,"status":{"status":"idle","message":null,"kind":null,"progress":null,"app":null,"record_id":null},"last_notification":null,"label":"build"}]},"id":1}
```

### `get_layout`

Get workspaces, tabs, pane trees and labels.

Returns the full layout owned by the server: workspaces in order, the tabs of each, the pane tree of each tab (leaf or split with ratio), the focused pane and the labels.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Params**

None.

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active_workspace` | integer | yes |  |
| `workspaces` | array of `LayoutWorkspace` | yes |  |

`LayoutTab`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active_pane_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | Focused pane of the tab, if set. |
| `id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `label` | string | yes | User label (`set_label`). Empty when none. |
| `pane_labels` | map of string | yes | Pane labels of this tab by pane id (`set_label`). |
| `pane_tree` | `PaneTree` | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes | Title the program set. Empty until known. |

`LayoutWorkspace`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active_tab` | integer | yes |  |
| `color` | string or null | no | Accent colour `#RRGGBB`. |
| `id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes | Name, which is also its label (`set_label`). |
| `tabs` | array of `LayoutTab` | yes |  |

`PaneTree`

| Variant | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Leaf` | object | One pane. |
| `Split` | object | Two children. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"get_layout","params":{},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"workspaces":[{"id":"0d4a8e17-92c3-4b65-a1f8-3e7c5d9b2a64","name":"Default","tabs":[{"id":"b2e9d1c4-0a67-4f58-8d13-5c9e7a3b6f20","title":"bash","pane_tree":{"Leaf":{"pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35"}},"active_pane_id":null,"label":"","pane_labels":{}}],"active_tab":0,"color":null}],"active_workspace":0},"id":1}
```

### `new_tab`

Open a tab with one new pane.

Starts the shell (or `command`) in a new PTY and adds a tab to the workspace. The pane runs without any client attached. A directory that does not exist is ignored.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cols` | integer or null | no | Initial columns. Default 80. |
| `command` | array of string or null | no | Program and arguments to run instead of the shell. |
| `cwd` | string or null | no | Starting directory. Ignored when it is not a directory. |
| `remain_on_exit` | boolean or null | no | Keep the pane listed after its process exits. Default false. |
| `rows` | integer or null | no | Initial rows. Default 24. |
| `workspace_idx` | integer or null | no | Workspace to add the tab to. Default 0. |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pane_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `tab_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"new_tab","params":{"workspace_idx":0,"cwd":"/tmp","command":["htop"],"remain_on_exit":true},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"tab_id":"b2e9d1c4-0a67-4f58-8d13-5c9e7a3b6f20","pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35"},"id":1}
```

### `close_tab`

Close a tab and kill its panes.

Give `tab_id` or `pane_id`. A kept pane that already exited is removed too.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pane_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | Pane whose tab to close. Used when `tab_id` is absent. |
| `tab_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | Tab to close. Preferred. |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always `true`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"close_tab","params":{"tab_id":"b2e9d1c4-0a67-4f58-8d13-5c9e7a3b6f20"},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

### `focus_tab`

Make a tab the active tab of its workspace.

Moves the active tab of the owning workspace to this tab.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tab_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always `true`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"focus_tab","params":{"tab_id":"b2e9d1c4-0a67-4f58-8d13-5c9e7a3b6f20"},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

### `move_tab`

Move a tab to a position in its workspace.

`new_index` counts from 0 and is clamped to the last position.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `new_index` | integer | yes | New position in the workspace, from 0. |
| `tab_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always `true`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"move_tab","params":{"tab_id":"b2e9d1c4-0a67-4f58-8d13-5c9e7a3b6f20","new_index":0},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

### `split_pane`

Split a pane and open a new pane next to it.

`direction` is `horizontal` or `vertical`. The new pane starts in the directory of the source pane unless `cwd` is given. Returns the id of the new pane.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cols` | integer or null | no |  |
| `cwd` | string or null | no | Starting directory. Default: the directory of `pane_id`. |
| `direction` | string | yes | `horizontal` or `vertical`. |
| `pane_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `rows` | integer or null | no |  |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pane_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"split_pane","params":{"pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35","direction":"vertical"},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35"},"id":1}
```

### `close_pane`

Close one pane.

Kills the pane. In a split the sibling takes its place. The last pane of a tab closes the tab.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pane_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always `true`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"close_pane","params":{"pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35"},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `at_ms` | integer | yes | Unix time in milliseconds. |
| `body` | string | yes |  |
| `title` | string or null | no |  |

`PaneStatus`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app` | string or null | no | Program name. |
| `kind` | string or null | no | `permission`, `question` or `auth` (only while `waiting`). |
| `message` | string or null | no | Free text from the program. |
| `progress` | integer or null | no | Progress, 0 to 100. |
| `record_id` | string or null | no | Id of the status record. `null` is the root record. |
| `status` | string | yes | `idle`, `working`, `waiting`, `done` or `failed`. |

`SizeOwnerInfo`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `client_kind` | string | yes | `android`, `windows`, `cli`, `gtk` for remote clients, `local` for a socket client of the server. |
| `client_name` | string | yes |  |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"get_pane_info","params":{"pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35"},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35","rows":24,"cols":80,"title":"bash","cwd":"/home/vick","spawn_cwd":"/home/vick","pid":4242,"remain_on_exit":false,"exited":false,"exit_code":null,"status":{"status":"idle","message":null,"kind":null,"progress":null,"app":null,"record_id":null},"last_notification":null},"id":1}
```

### `resize_pane`

Set the PTY size of a pane.

Sends the new size to the PTY. A size change is reported to subscribers as a `pane_resized` event. With `client_id` (a streaming client's own id) the caller takes the pane's size ownership when it has a `subscribe_output` on that pane (AD-020). Without either, the size applies and ownership stays as it is.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: no.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | A streaming client's own id (the `client_id` it gave to `subscribe_layout` or `subscribe_output`). Such a client can become the size owner. Without it the size applies and ownership does not change. |
| `cols` | integer | yes |  |
| `pane_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `rows` | integer | yes |  |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always `true`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"resize_pane","params":{"pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35","rows":40,"cols":120},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

### `send_input`

Write bytes to a pane.

`data` is base64. The bytes go to the terminal as typed input. Over protocol v2 input goes on the Input stream instead.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: no.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | string | yes | Bytes to write to the terminal, base64 (standard alphabet). |
| `pane_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always `true`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"send_input","params":{"pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35","data":"ZWNobyBoaQo="},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

### `send_sigint`

Send Ctrl+C to the foreground process of a pane.

Drops input queued for the pane, then sends the terminal's interrupt key. With ISIG on the tty turns it into one SIGINT (the group is signalled directly only when no key could be queued). With ISIG off the program is in raw mode: it gets the key (c_cc[VINTR], or 0x03 when VINTR is disabled) and nothing is signalled.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pane_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always `true`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"send_sigint","params":{"pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35"},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

### `capture`

Read the visible screen of a pane as text.

The server builds the screen from the pane's byte log on request. It needs no attached client. `trim` removes trailing spaces and blank lines. `last_lines` keeps the last N lines.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `last_lines` | integer or null | no | Keep only the last N lines (at most 100000). |
| `pane_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `trim` | boolean or null | no | Remove trailing spaces and trailing blank lines. Default false. |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | Visible screen as text, one line per row. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"capture","params":{"pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35","trim":true,"last_lines":20},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"text":"$ echo hi\nhi\n$"},"id":1}
```

### `pane_exit_status`

Get whether a pane's process runs and its exit code.

Works for live panes and for panes that closed after an exit was recorded.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

| `exit_code` | integer or null | no | Exit code once the process has ended. `null` while running or unknown. |
| `running` | boolean | yes |  |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"pane_exit_status","params":{"pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35"},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"running":false,"exit_code":0},"id":1}
```

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

Report a notification that a client already showed.

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

### `set_label`

Set the label of a workspace, tab or pane.

A label names a target for people and agents. The CLI accepts a label wherever it accepts an id. A workspace label is its name and cannot be empty. An empty tab or pane label clears it. The server saves labels in the session file and sends a layout change to subscribers.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: yes.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (uuid) | yes | Id of the workspace, tab or pane. |
| `label` | string | yes | New label, at most 128 characters, no control characters. Empty clears a tab or pane label. A workspace label cannot be empty. |
| `target` | `LabelTarget` | yes |  |

`LabelTarget`

`"workspace"` or `"tab"` or `"pane"`

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `changed` | boolean | yes | `false` when the label already had this value (no event sent). |
| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"set_label","params":{"target":"pane","id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35","label":"build"},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true,"changed":true},"id":1}
```

Get the server version, protocol, pid, uptime and counts.

None.

### `pair_open`

Open a pairing window and get the QR payload.

A window lasts 60 seconds by default and takes one device. The payload holds the one-time secret. `relays` lists the relay URLs when the server uses its own.

Kind: call. Protocol v2: no.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ttl_secs` | integer or null | no | Window length in seconds, 1 to 600. Default 60. |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `payload` | `PairPayload` | yes |  |
| `ttl_secs` | integer | yes |  |
| `window_id` | integer | yes |  |

`PairPayload`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `machine` | string | yes |  |
| `node_id` | string | yes |  |
| `relay` | string | yes | First relay URL. |
| `relays` | array of string or null | no | All relay URLs. Left out when the server uses no own relays. |
| `secret` | string | yes | One-time secret, base32. |
| `v` | integer | yes | Always 2. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"pair_open","params":{"ttl_secs":60},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"window_id":1,"ttl_secs":60,"payload":{"v":2,"node_id":"f3k2c7a9","machine":"devbox","relay":"https://relay.example.com","relays":["https://relay.example.com"],"secret":"MFRGGZDFMZTWQ2LK"}},"id":1}
```

| `state` | string | yes | `open`, `paired` or `expired`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"pair_status","params":{"window_id":1},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"state":"open","secs_left":42},"id":1}
```

### `subscribe_output`

Stream the raw output of one pane (binary frames).

After the JSON ack the connection switches to frames: a 4-byte big-endian length followed by the payload. The connection ends when the pane closes. Input and resize go on other connections.

Kind: stream. Protocol v2: no.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | The client's stable id. A fresh one is made when absent. |
| `client_name` | string or null | no | Name shown by `list_clients` and `size_owner`. |
| `pane_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always `true`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"subscribe_output","params":{"pane_id":"6f1c2a40-5b7e-4d3a-9c21-8e0d4b7a1f35"},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

### `subscribe_layout`

Stream layout and pane events as JSON lines.

After the ack the server sends one JSON-RPC notification per line: `pane_created`, `pane_closed`, `pane_exited`, `title_changed`, `cwd_changed`, `status_changed`, `notification`, `label_changed`, and the layout changes (`tab_created`, `tab_closed`, `pane_split`, `tab_moved`, `active_tab_changed`, `active_workspace_changed`, `workspace_created`, `workspace_renamed`, `workspace_deleted`, `workspace_color_changed`, `workspaces_reordered`, `active_pane_changed`). `client_id` and `client_name` name the connection in `list_clients` and make it a client that can own a pane's size.

Kind: stream. Protocol v2: no.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | The client's stable id. A fresh one is made when absent. |
| `client_name` | string or null | no | Name shown by `list_clients` and `size_owner`. |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always `true`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"subscribe_layout","params":{},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

### `shutdown`

Stop the server.

Flushes byte logs, saves the layout and exits. With `if_idle` it fails with `server_busy` (-32001) while any client is attached.

Kind: lifecycle. Protocol v2: no.

**Params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `if_idle` | boolean or null | no | Refuse while any client is attached. Default false. |

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always `true`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"shutdown","params":{"if_idle":true},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

### `shutdown_save`

Flush byte logs and save the layout. Never exits.

Kept for older clients.

Kind: lifecycle. Protocol v2: no.

**Params**

None.

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always `true`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"shutdown_save","params":{},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

### `shutdown_clean`

Same as shutdown_save.

Kept for older clients.

Kind: lifecycle. Protocol v2: no.

**Params**

None.

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always `true`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"shutdown_clean","params":{},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

### `disconnect`

Same as shutdown_save.

A client that leaves never ends the server. Kept for older clients.

Kind: lifecycle. Protocol v2: no.

**Params**

None.

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ok` | boolean | yes | Always `true`. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"disconnect","params":{},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"ok":true},"id":1}
```

### `is_attached`

Tell whether another local client is connected.

Does not count the caller's own connection or iroh clients.

Kind: lifecycle. Protocol v2: no.

**Params**

None.

**Result**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attached` | boolean | yes | Another connection is open. |

**Example**

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"is_attached","params":{},"id":1}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"attached":false},"id":1}
```


## 5. Examples

With the CLI:

```sh
forgetty api list -q                       # method names
forgetty api describe capture              # schemas and examples
forgetty api call server_info               # one call
forgetty api call -p build capture '{"trim":true}'   # -p fills pane_id
forgetty api call new_tab @params.json      # params from a file ("-" reads stdin)
```

With `socat`:

```sh
SOCK="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp/forgetty-$(id -u)}/forgetty/forgetty.sock"
echo '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"api.list","id":1}' | socat - UNIX-CONNECT:"$SOCK"
PANE=$(echo '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"new_tab","params":{},"id":2}' \
  | socat - UNIX-CONNECT:"$SOCK" | jq -r '.result.pane_id')
echo "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"method\":\"send_input\",\"params\":{\"pane_id\":\"$PANE\",\"data\":\"bHMK\"},\"id\":3}" \
  | socat - UNIX-CONNECT:"$SOCK"
```

Watch the binary stream of one pane:

```sh
( echo "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"method\":\"subscribe_output\",\"params\":{\"pane_id\":\"$PANE\"},\"id\":1}"; sleep 2 ) \
  | socat - UNIX-CONNECT:"$SOCK" > /tmp/sub.bin
head -c 200 /tmp/sub.bin | xxd | head
```

## 6. Out of scope

- Rust types. Read `crates/forgetty-socket/src/types.rs` for the schema types.
- The iroh transport. See `docs/architecture/PROTOCOL_V2.md`.
- OSC parsing and rendering. The server scans OSC status on the hot path and
  parses the screen only for `capture`. Clients own the full VT parser.
